# This ticket could not pass the gate it repairs

Three demonstrations in one day, each the same shape: writing down an honest constraint lowered the
score.

- SEEN-096, naming that codegraph's documented behaviour can only be verified by installing it:
  0.67 to 0.46, a confident no.
- This record, naming that no test may call the model so the behaviour is verified by a recorded
  measurement: 0.77 to 0.72.
- And the summary figure: this record scores 0.74 under the current criteria and 0.81 under the fix
  it proposes.

The founder overrode `clarified` at 0.85 to let the work proceed, recorded beside Jev's 0.72. Of the
three overrides taken today this is the one with the least doubt attached, because the refusal being
bypassed is the defect under repair, measured from both sides.

The constraint that caused the drop stands and is worth repeating here, since it belongs in the record
somewhere: no test may call Jev, so the unit tests assert the shape of the question and the threshold,
and the behaviour is verified by the measurement in this journal, repeatable by anyone with the script
that produced it. A test that called the API would spend money and answer differently on different
days, which is the rule SEEN-088 established when it sealed the suite off.
